lines: After the afternoon combat training was over, we went to the headmistress's office.
Thank you for coming, you three.
There was another woman besides Asagi-sensei in the headmistress's office.
She sat on the couch with a cigarette in her mouth and gave us a slight nod.
(She's not one of our senpai... right? I haven't seen her around the academy before.)
(A-And look!! She's drinking alcohol, isn't she? Is that okay, in the headmistress's office...?)
While we were whispering, Asagi-sensei started to speak.
So... I heard the story, Fuma-kun.
The incident the other dayーthe Nisha Gaiza incident, it must have been hard on you. How is your body?
Ah, y-yes. I seem to have made it out in one piece somehow...
Unfortunately it had ended up being a report after the fact, but I had also told Asagi-sensei about the fight with Gaiza.
I'm sorry. I went and acted without your orders...
Yes. But that isn't a problem. The Independent Commando Unit was designed to function without direct orders from the beginning.
You are free to act at your own discretion if you deem it necessary.
I guess that was how much she trusted me.
(But it also means that I can't do anything unwise...)
Asagi-sensei's calm trust made my whole body tense up.
More importantly, you are physically in good health. I have high hopes for you, and I would be in a bind if you were to step down from your post now.
No way I'd...!? I absolutely won't quit until I catch that basーuntil I catch Gaiza with my own hands!!
Hehe. That's the spirit. So, once again, I have a new mission for you allーSana.
On Asagi-sensei's cue, the woman who had been sitting on the sofa with a cigarette in her hand stood up.
Nice to meet you, yeah. You're the kids of the Independent Commando Unit. I'm Kozuki Sana. I've heard about you from Asagi-san.
Way too formal. Just Sana is fine. I mean, I'm a graduate of this school, and we'll be doing the mission together after all♪
She spoke in a casual manner and grinned.
She didn't really give off a Taimanin vibe... but still seemed oddly impressive.
Hey, Shikanosuke... You're so jittery you're hardly making a peep.
Ah!? Uh, um... nice to meet you, Sana-senpai. I'm Uehara Shikanosuke...
Oh! Fuma and Shikanosuke, got it. That means you over there must be Hebiko, the octopus ninja, right?
Y-Yes, Hebiko here... Um... Sana-san, you really are a Taimanin, yes?
Perhaps having the same thoughts as me, Hebiko asked Sana timidly.
Hehe. Hebiko, despite how she looks, Sana is a swordswoman of the Ace Katana Style.
The Ace Katana Style was a Taima Sword Art that Akiyama Rinko-senpai and the recently encountered Shishigami Jisai, among others, were proficient in.
Come to think of it, Sana-san had indeed strapped a large sword to her shoulder.
I can vouch for her strength as a Taimanin. And although she is acting like a bad girl right now, in reality she is serious and hardworking.
Wha-!? Asagi-san, gimme a break~!! I-I'm not a hard worker at all!!!
Umm... See? I'm a "bad girl," just look at me!!
Hehe, alright, alright. Whatever you say.
Asagi-sensei laughed as if she found the flushed and flustered Sana-san amusing.
(Mmhmm... There sure are all sorts of weirdos in the Taimanin.)
Enough about me already! Asagi-san, let's talk about the mission.
Yes, you're right... What I'm asking you to do this time is an undercover mission.
Asagi-sensei turned to us and got straight to the point.
You will infiltrate the "Underground City" Yomihara together with Sana.
Whaaaaa!? I already got a really bad feeling about this mission...!
